slides.title: Kenya adds police at Moyale border
slides.body: Capital FM: more officers sent as thousands who fled Ethiopia are sheltered. Figures unverified.

slides.title: China's Africa envoy meets Ethiopia's foreign minister
slides.body: Ethiopia's ministry says they discussed regional peace and security. Via Borkena.

slides.title: CPJ urges Ethiopia to lift The Reporter suspension
slides.body: Media authority cited "national interests". CPJ asked for comment; no response yet.

slides.title: Back tomorrow at 11 PM.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
